scenario: contains is EXACT — a value never observed is not contained (LSER.16.7.1). Asserting only "info" tags, `contains(e.tag, "error")` stays false (an approximate Bloom filter could false-positive; the exact SeriesBackendRingBuffer set cannot). Pin: the rule never fires — its action_log is forbidden. The companion LSER.16.7.1.runtime confirms the backend is loaded and does fire when the value is present.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    tag: String mutable

series Event.tag:
    contains sliding 5_s

rule never_fires:
    Event e where contains(e.tag, "error")
->
    log info "should not fire"
